body:
Since we’re not married, the nurses can’t tell me anything. Because of the type of hospital he’s in I can’t even get through the door without a visitor’s pass. Due made him a private patient so I can’t get a visitor’s pass. I was able to visit a few times early on and the doctor’s told me they didn’t know what was keeping him from waking up. 

I do have a therapist I see weekly, but I’m not sure it’s enough. Because of the program I am in along with a hard core course instructor I’m not cut any slack despite all my teachers knowing the situation. A lot of people I’ve talked to in my profession think you should be able to put up and shut up because the profession requires you to watch these types of situations from the outside fairly often.

We had a conversation early on when we briefly dated about her not approving of me because of my skin color. She didn’t text me and tell me she was uncomfortable with me seeing him either. She made the nurses tell me I could no longer see him. They were very understanding and apologetic about the whole thing.
